story: Sophie is in the garden. Sophie sees a little fairy sitting on a red flower. The fairy has a tiny crown. The crown is on the grass. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie picks up the tiny crown. Sophie holds it out to the fairy. [gesture:clapping] The fairy takes the crown and claps her small hands. Sophie and the fairy sit on the big green chair. The fairy puts three shiny stars on Sophie's hand. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is happy in the garden.
